and [[The Dawn of Rebellion]] | followed by = [[Polymock: Defeat Master Hoff]] }} Learn how to face unusual pieces by defeating the [[Charr]] polymock player. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== *Defeat [[Dune Teardrinker]] in a game of Polymock at [[Doomlore Shrine]]. *See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward. ===Reward=== *250 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]] *[[Aloe Seed Polymock piece|Aloe Seed Polymock Piece]] *{{skill icon|Summon Naga Shaman}} ==Walkthrough== Dune Teardrinker's pieces and their unique skills are as follows: #[[Charr Shaman Form|Charr Shaman]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Smite}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Piercing Light Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Signet of Smiting}} #[[Charr Flamecaller Form|Charr Flamecaller]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Flare}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Fireball}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Mind Blast}} #[[Titan Form|Titan]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Flare}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Savannah Heat}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Rodgort's Invocation}} *Use the [[Earth Elemental Polymock piece|Earth Elemental]] against the [[Charr Shaman Form|Charr Shaman]]. *Use the [[Fire Elemental Polymock piece|Fire Elemental]] or [[Fire Imp Polymock piece|Fire Imp]] against the [[Charr Flamecaller Form|Charr Flamecaller]]. *Use the [[Kappa Polymock piece|Kappa]] against the [[Titan Form|Titan]]. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Hoff :''I've arranged a match for you against a particularly vicious opponent. He's the only Charr I've encountered with the patience and skill to learn the game. [[Dune Teardrinker]] is his name. His pieces are so rare you may never find others like them. Be careful if you win, though. Charr don't take kindly to losing.'' {{offer dialog |accept = The only tears he'll be drinking will be his own. |decline = I don't want to get eaten. |ask = Defeat [[Dune Teardrinker]] at [[Doomlore Shrine]] in a game of Polymock. |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Hoff :''Congratulations! Not only did you defeat Dune Teardrinker, but you returned in one piece!'' ==Notes== *Be careful. Sometimes the Titan Polymock piece uses [[Polymock Savannah Heat]] as a last attack just before you hit him with the final attack that will make you win. The result of this is, you defeat him, but then die because of the [[Polymock Savannah Heat]] and you must go back to the outpost. You also then have to defeat him again.
